url.description: Page or feed URL to crawl for events.

type.description: Source kind. 'auto' (default) detects RSS vs HTML; 'rss' forces feed parsing; 'html' forces page scraping; 'bookmanager' uses the BookManager JSON API (headless); 'tribe' uses the WordPress The Events Calendar REST API; 'eventbrite' scrapes Eventbrite's public search page (headless); 'wix' uses the Wix Events API (headless); 'squareonline' renders a Square Online page and parses events from its __BOOTSTRAP_STATE__ (headless).

enabled.description: Skip this source when false. Defaults true.

render.description: Use headless-browser rendering for JS-heavy pages.

details.description: Set false to skip the detail-page stage and use the index page's events directly (for HTML sources whose links point elsewhere).

search.description: Search parameters for discovery sources (e.g. type 'eventbrite').

pages.description: Max search result pages to read.

file.description: For type 'static': path (relative to project root) to the hand-maintained events JSON.

locationName.description: For sources whose events don't carry a location (e.g. 'squareonline', 'acuity'): a fixed location string to attach to every event from this source.

acuity.description: For type 'acuity': Squarespace Scheduling/Acuity booking identifiers.

calendarId.description: Calendar id used by the availability API.

timezone.description: IANA tz for availability queries (default America/Denver).

months.description: How many months ahead to query (default 4).

note.description: Free-form note; ignored by the crawler.
